result.summary:
PASS (bookkeeping only; the release to main stays with RELEASE-FINALIZER step 11 and the owner's permission, R1). Verdict derived by me from my own runs of 2026-11-03/04, not from reports.

CRITERIA (the defect has no acceptance_criteria; REQ-104 is done and not returned to in_progress, so only the defect claims and the criteria touched by the fix were checked):
1 met - the fix is in tests only: git diff base/ISS-0103-20261103-01 against the working tree = tools/test/e2e-kit.test.js + docs/program/public-v1/PROGRESS.md (ORCH progress file); tools/src and tools/test/e2e fixtures/kit untouched; no new skip/only/todo in the diff.
2 met - the three exposed places (E2K-18 assertion, E2K-38 signal loop, E2K-38 preflight loop) use waitGone (pid and group ESRCH, bound 5000 ms); E2K-63 pins their use.
3 met - the original error is reproduced in its deterministic form and gone (self_check R1-R3): a killed, not reaped victim (ps state Z) makes the old single check pidGone&&groupGone false on the tag; on the current tree the same hold is waited through (settled=false after 500 ms) and ends true after release.
4 met - E2K-18 30 of 30 and E2K-38 30 of 30 green under 8 busy loops on the current tree; E2K-63 goes red with the message naming test and line when E2K-18 is put back to the single check (own mutant in a copy).
5 met on GitHub - run 41701454358 green (see self_check G).
6 neighbours (AP-014) - I looked for any further single check after a kill: every other pidGone/groupGone in e2e-kit.test.js is either after an in-process awaited close/abort of the kit (which polls kill(-pgid,0) and lets libuv reap), inside until(...) (lines 2528, 3561, 3642, 3741), or after waitGone (3128-3129); other test files (exec-closure, team-helpers/recovery, team-writer assertDead) check a child run with spawnSync, which has reaped it. None exposed; I found none missed. This is a reading of the call sites, not a measured fact for every one.

QUALITY BAR: Q1 PASS (ISS-0103 tied to REQ-104). Q2 PASS (own check run, own repro, own GitHub run). Q3 PASS (outputs below; the Linux zombie-vs-slow fact is NOT measured on the runner: docker absent; the cause is confirmed in kind on macOS under load, 3 of 160 in the diagnosis, and by one natural red on the tag; the green runner run is one sample, not proof the flake cannot recur, so the closing text must say 'fix by waiting for the death; Linux state at the failure not measured'). Q4 PASS (npm run check once, exit 0). Q5 PASS (E2K-62 deterministic regression fails on the old way, E2K-63 guards call sites). Q6 PASS (no skip/only, no weaker assertion: the single check became a stronger bounded wait; no repeat of the run). Q7 PASS (no secret in the diff; E2K-50 green). Q8, Q9, Q10, Q11 not applicable (test-only change about process death, no data/SQL/external call/address). Q12 PASS (decisions/0107, 0108 not contradicted; an addendum to 0108 is listed for DOC-UPDATER). Q13 open until DOC-UPDATER writes the anti-patterns entry (listed). Q14 open until DOC-UPDATER step 10 (listed; not lagging yet because the step has not run). R1 PASS (nothing merged; the branch was temporary and deleted; main unchanged). R2 not applicable (no Pixel Office event written). R3 not applicable (dropped by decisions/0033).

RESULT in plain words: the flaky test is fixed by waiting (with a limit) until the killed stand-in is really gone; the deterministic reproduction shows the old check fails and the new one waits through; the whole check is green locally (2187 of 2187, e2e 13 of 13) and on GitHub on a snapshot equal to the working files.
